ChangelogPage.title: Changelog
ChangelogPage.description: Track new features, improvements, bug fixes, and API updates across Graphood Developer API releases.

changes.initial: The first official release of the Graphood Developer API.
changes.meEndpoint: Added the <code1>/me</code1> endpoint to retrieve the current system and tenant status.
changes.healthEndpoint: Added the <code1>/health</code1> endpoint for service health monitoring.
changes.auth: Introduced API key authentication using Bearer Token.
changes.schema: Standardized the API JSON response schema and error structure.

ErrorsPage.title: Errors
ErrorsPage.description: Graphood Developer API returns standard HTTP status codes with a consistent JSON error format to help you troubleshoot issues quickly.

errorFormat.title: Error Response Format
errorFormat.description: When an API request fails, the server responds with a success flag of <code1>false</code1> and a detailed error object:

list.badRequest: The request was invalid or contained incorrect parameters.
list.unauthorized: Authentication failed or the API key was missing or invalid.
list.forbidden: Access to the requested resource or tenant was denied.
list.notFound: The requested resource, tenant, or endpoint could not be found.

list.INVALID_API_KEY: The provided API key is invalid or malformed.
list.MISSING_API_KEY: The Authorization header was not provided in the request.
list.SYSTEM_NOT_FOUND: The requested system could not be found or is inactive.
list.TENANT_NOT_FOUND: The requested tenant slug could not be found.
list.UNKNOWN_ERROR: An unhandled or unexpected error occurred in the internal server.

ResponseFormatPage.title: Response Format
ResponseFormatPage.description: All responses returned by the Graphood Developer API follow a consistent JSON structure. Successful and failed requests always share the same base schema.

successfulResponse.title: Successful Response
successfulResponse.description: When a request succeeds, the <code1>success</code1> field is set to <code2>true</code2> and the requested data is included inside <code3>data</code3>.

errorResponse.title: Error Response
errorResponse.description: When a request fails, <code1>success</code1> is set to <code2>false</code2> and an <code3>error</code3> object is returned with the error code and message.

list.success: Indicates whether the request succeeded (true) or failed (false).
list.data: Contains the requested data or resource. Only appears in successful responses.
list.error: Contains error details including the code and message. Only appears when a request fails.

AuthenticationPage.title: Authentication
AuthenticationPage.description: Graphood Developer API uses API keys for authenticating requests. Include your API key in the Authorization header for all protected endpoints.

method.title: Authentication Method
method.description: Graphood uses Bearer Token authentication. Every protected request must include your API key in the <code1>Authorization</code1> header.

generate.title: Generate an API Key
generate.description: Create an API key from your developer dashboard:

steps.step5: Copy the generated key and store it somewhere safe.

list.MISSING_API_KEY: The Authorization header was not provided in the request.
list.INVALID_API_KEY: The provided API key is invalid or malformed.
list.REVOKED_API_KEY: The API key has been revoked and can no longer be used.
list.SYSTEM_NOT_FOUND: The API key does not belong to an active system.

list.item1: <strong1>Never expose API keys</strong1> in the frontend or public client-side code.
list.item2: Store API keys in secure environment variables.
list.item3: Rotate API keys regularly to reduce risk.
list.item4: Revoke API keys that are exposed or suspected to be compromised immediately.
list.item5: Use HTTPS exclusively for all API requests in production.
